summary: Direct Digital Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing amendments to its term loan facility and committed equity facility. The borrower amended the Term Loan Facility, waiving noncompliance with financial covenants for Q1 2026 and nonpayment of interest for April 2026. It reduced the minimum consolidated EBITDA covenant to $200k for Q2 2026 and removed minimum revenue requirements for its sell-side advertising business. A $0.1M amendment fee is payable on May 31, 2026. Separately, Roth Principal Investments agreed to reimburse 0.6% of VWAP per purchase under the equity facility. These modifications signal ongoing financial distress and covenant relief, with risk-arb focus on liquidity and earnings turnaround.
